Fencer Bhavani Devi Apologizes, Seeks Reduction of Suspension

Indian fencer Bhavani Devi has issued an apology and requested a reconsideration of her two-month suspension. The Fencing Association has expressed hope that her suspension might be reduced. The details surrounding the suspension and the specific reasons for the apology were not provided in the coverage.
